notes.title: Ver.5.35 "Twin Fates" Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Authorizers,



Thank you for supporting Tower of Fantasy! We will be carrying out a maintenance update to bring you a better gaming experience. After the update, version 5.35 "Twin Fates" will be released.



After the update, servers The Morning Star and Takoyaki, as well as Rainbow Road and Nirvana, will be merged. Please check the official announcement for more details.

The Limited-Time Plotti Reissue event will end after the update. The weapon EP-7000 Skyfire will be added to the Choice Weapons special order event, and the Plotti Matrix will be added to the Choice Matrices special order event.



◤Update Time◢

September 23, 04:00 - 08:00(UTC+0)

(Server opening time may be delayed or brought forward based on maintenance situation.)



◤How to Update◢

Resource Update: Once the server goes offline, you can update the game in advance and play the new version as soon as it reopens. We recommend using Wi-Fi for updates on mobile devices.

How to Update

PC & PlayStation:

1. After the server shuts down, manually exit the client and restart it to begin the update.

2. Once the resource update starts downloading, you can minimize the window, and it will continue in the background.

Note: The PC & PlayStation login system has been upgraded. If you experience a login error after updating, restart the client and log out before logging back in. If the issue persists, contact customer support.

Android & iOS:

1. After the server shuts down, download the new version from your app store.

2. Launch the game to start the resource update, which will continue in the background.

Server Shutdown Notice: We recommend exiting the game at least 15 minutes before the update. To prevent issues, avoid making purchases within 5 minutes before the server shuts down, as this may affect gameplay or cause account asset loss.

Dark Crystal * 400

We will send the above compensation to your mailbox within 2 hours after the maintenance update is complete. The mail will be valid for 7 days, so please be sure to claim it in time.

notes.title: Important: Notice of Publisher and Operation Changes
notes.notes:
Dear Authorizers,
Level Infinite would like to share some important news about Tower of Fantasy. Starting from February 23, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0), the game will be published, operated, and managed by Perfect World Games , the parent company of Hotta Studio.

Please accept the transfer of your Tower of Fantasy data to a Perfect World Games Account in order to ensure your game progress, virtual currency, items, and purchased services remain unaffected.
We're committed to making the transition to a new publisher for Tower of Fantasy as seamless as possible. Rest assured, our servers will remain active until February 23, 2025, at 16:00 (UTC+0), ensuring you can continue enjoying the same high-quality gaming experience you've come to love.
Here is the important information you need to know:

1. How Will This Affect Tower of Fantasy Data?
To allow users to continue playing Tower of Fantasy with their existing gaming progress, we will open a "Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization Verification" page from December 27, 2024 to April 24, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0).

Users who agree to transfer their data will have their Tower of Fantasy data migrated to the new publisher. Users who do not agree to the transfer or fail to authorize the transfer within the specified timeframe will have their Tower of Fantasy data deleted.

For details on what Tower of Fantasy Data is transferred, please refer to the User Notice on the "Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization Verification" page.

2. How to Authorize Data Transfer?
2.1 For users logging in via LEVEL INFINITE PASS, Apple, Google, Facebook, X, Line, or Steam:

Users can authorize the transfer and link to a Perfect World Account by accessing the "Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization Verification" page through an in-game pop-up after logging in.
Note: The authorization page will be open from December 27, 2024 to April 24, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0).  You need to confirm on this page whether you agree to the Tower of Fantasy Data Transfer. After the change of publisher "Tower of Fantasy" will adhere to the new publisher's privacy policy. Please read the "Perfect World Games Privacy Policy" carefully before authorizing data transfer.
EN:  PRIVACY POLICY
JA：プライバシー・ポリシー

2.2 For users using guest accounts or Epic Games accounts:
Note: Due to platform restrictions on guest data and the discontinuation of support for the Epic Games platform, data cannot be directly transferred.
Those users must first link their account to a LEVEL INFINITE PASS account by February 23, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0), and then complete the authorization process on the "Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization Verification" page to avoid data loss.

3. What If I Do Not Consent to the Tower of Fantasy Data Transfer?
You can choose to wait until the Level Infinite server shuts down without making a decision, or you can opt to decline the data transfer authorization on the "Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization" page. After selecting, you will still be able to play until the Level Infinite servers shut down on February 23, 2025 at 16:00 (UTC+0). All related Tower of Fantasy data under your Level Infinite account will be deleted on April 30, 2025 at 16:00 (UTC+0).
To avoid loss of your gaming rights or affecting your normal gaming experience, please consider carefully before confirming your decision.
Alternatively, you can request data deletion in advance via the in-game Settings > Compliance Management > Data Privacy section, and we will assist you in completing the process.

4. Can I Modify My Transfer Decision?
You can modify your transfer decision through “Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization" page before February 23, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0). After this date, changes to your authorization decision will no longer be permitted.

5. Publisher Transition Timeline
● December 27, 2024: "Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization" page goes live.
● December 27, 2024 to February 23, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0): Data transfer and decision modification period.
● February 14, 2025 04:00 (UTC+0): Transition of store/app publishing rights; in-game top-up services disabled.
● February 23, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0): Level Infinite servers officially shut down; original Customer Service and related services discontinued.
● The go live date for the new server will be announced by Perfect World Games.
 .
● February 23 16:00 to April 24, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0) (Extended Data Transfer Confirmation Period): Extended authorization confirmation period to give users more time for additional data transfers.
● April 24, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0): Final closure of "Tower of Fantasy Account Transfer and Authorization" page.
● April 30, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0): Tower of Fantasy data for which authorization was declined or not completed will be deleted.

6. Who to Contact About Your Data Rights?
● Before data transfer:
Before >February 23, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0), we will continue to handle game operations and Tower of Fantasy data. For questions or data rights inquiries, please refer to the User Agreement ( https://www.toweroffantasy-global.com/UserAgreement.html) and Privacy Policy ( https://www.toweroffantasy-global.com/PrivacyPolicy.html) or contact us.

● After data transfer:
After February 23, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0), the new publisher will take over game operations.The new publisher will also handle Tower of Fantasy data management.In case of any inquiries or if you wish to exercise your data subject rights, please do not hesitate to contact Perfect World Games.
Please note that once the transition is complete, your User Agreement with us will no longer apply to the game. Any terms and conditions will be governed by the new user agreement established by the new publisher. Starting from February 23, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0), please contact the new publisher directly for any issues, complaints, or disputes related to game operations.

7. How to Contact
If you have any questions or concerns regarding this notice, please contact us via in-game Customer Service or mail before February 23, 2025 16:00 (UTC+0).

Thank you for your continued support. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused. Please stay tuned for further updates to ensure a smooth gaming experience.

Level Infinite

notes.title: Tower of Fantasy Version 2.4 Updates
notes.notes:
Dear Wanderers,
Thank you for supporting Tower of Fantasy! To enhance your gaming experience, we will be shutting down our servers for game resource updates and maintenance, and the Ver. 2.4 The Grand Sea will become available once the update is finished.
During the maintenance, you will not be able to log in to the game. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. The details of the update and compensation are as follows:

◤Update Time◢
March 30 06:00–09:00 (UTC+0) (Depending on maintenance conditions, the server may be back online later or earlier than scheduled)

◤Update Method◢
● Resource Updates: Considering the large size of the update, we recommend finishing the update procedure once the server is down so you can experience the new version as soon as it is back up. Wi-Fi is recommended for downloading the update. The instructions for updating are provided below.
◆ PC: Expected Update Size - 19G
1. After the server is down, please exit and restart the game client manually, then update the launcher.
2. Please click Update in the launcher. Once the resource has begun downloading, you can minimize the launcher window. Updates will be carried out in the background until they are complete.
Special Reminder: The launcher on the Pc will be updated this time. If you encounter an error after the update, please log out and restart the launcher before logging in again. If the problem persists, please get in touch with customer service.
◆ Android : Expected Update Size - 0.91G (App Resource); 14G (after logging in)
◆ iOS: Expected Update Size - 2.49G (App Resource); 11.78G (after logging in)
1. This update requires a new package. Please go to the app store of your mobile device to download the latest version of the app once the server has been taken down.
2. Once the game is activated and started to download, you may run it in the background until the update finishes.
● Server-down maintenance: We suggest that you log off 15 minutes before updating commences, and please do not make purchases 5 minutes before the server is down in order to avoid negative gaming experiences and losses of your in-game properties.

◤Compensation◢
Maintenance compensation:  300 dark crystals 
Client update compensation:  200 Dark Crystals
Dream Machine Adjustment compensation: spacetime crystal fragments*40
New section in Raid: Spatial Reorganizer I*1 (which can grants another reward chance for Raids)
- Compensation eligibility: Reach Wanderer Lv. 6 before the update
- We will deliver the aforementioned compensation to you via mail within 2 hours after the maintenance. Do remember to check your mailbox and claim them
◤Updates◢
◆ New Gameplay
1. Chapter 10 Main Story
New chapters are unlocked in the main story, in which Wanderers will encounter many new and old friends along the journey to unmask the truth of Abyssants together!
2. New Map: Grand Sea
Wanderers can start their exploration from top to bottom through the upper level of the Grand Sea Island, transiting through Innars, then go all the way to the Dragon Breath Volcano which lies deep underwater. Come and experience a unique underwater ecosystem, many interacting battles, and puzzle-solving gameplay.
3. New Underwater Vehicles
There are 3 underwater vehicles added to the new map: Diamond Wings, Vision Sphere, and Sunfish, which Wanderers can obtain through the Gachapon Machine.
4. Underwater Request Mission
With the new map content, optimized request missions, and upgraded mission rewards, Wanderers can now get themselves a full set of gold equipment in a short period of time by completing the underwater Appointed Research!
5. New World Boss
In the new map, there are two new world bosses, Abyssant: Scylla, who lives in the Grand Sea, and Abyssant: Haboela, in the volcano center. They await Wanderers to challenge.
6. Revamped Sequential Phantasm
First season availability: After the version update till 2023/05/11 05:00 (Server Time)
The stage design of the revised Sequential Phantasm mechanism for the season is much more enjoyable and interesting and topped with even more fantastic rewards. Hurry and challenge yourself with different lineups!
7. New Instance: Ring of Oblivion
The latest Raid instance for the team is added with a special positive/negative current explosion mechanism, enhancing the fun and challenge altogether! Join forces with your teammate and crusade against the big boss Abyssant: Eva, to showcase your skills!
8. Other New Content
a) Added the quick battle feature in Dimensional Trials and Interstellar Exploration
b) Added buffs for Wanderers when they enter the Joint Operation solo or with low power to improve the combat experience
c) Added the bullet module settings when activating Clover Cross for the first time
d) Obtain exclusive outfits or outfit shards by opening the world boss chest (or through the forced decryption)
e) Added two sets of new servers: North America-Oasis, Southeast Asia-Tore de Utopia (available after the update).
f) Unlocked new levels for Suppressor
g) New Mira Gachapon Machines and Old Vera Coin Gachapon Machines in Mirroria City
h) Made it possible for Wanderers to enter other Wanderers' Artificial Island in Building Mode
i) Added New NPC and function: Artificial Island Mysterious Vendorn
j) Added quick equip function to Matrix Set

Event Time: After the version 2.4 update till (UTC+0) 2023/05/10 21:00

◆ Optimizations and Bug Fixes
The detailed adjustments can be viewed in ""Version 2.4 Preview"" on the official website.
1. Revamped the flow of the gameplay for beginners
2. Optimized the difficulty of some instances
3. Improved the strength of weapons in the Weapons Galore in general
4. Spacetime crystal fragments can be used to exchange for the fortress tactics eyepiece limited to a certain amount in Spacetime Store every week
5. Increased the rewards dropped in some original modes
6. Improved the overall UI, lightening the tone and style to be more minimalistic and giving it a techie feeling
7. Optimized PC controller experience
8. Fixed the abnormal display of the server list labels
9. We will add the restriction function for the NEW chance-UP Matrix. The function of restriction only applies to Matrix Special Orders (including Reissues) of Lan as well as the new Simulacra released after Lan. Matrix Special Orders (including Reissues) of the Simulacra released before Lan do not have access to this function
10. Added the Russian text option in the game (Show this line only in the European area)
11. Optimized the line break rules for the in-game text
12. Fixed the abnormal truncation problem in some black screens
13. Optimized the voiceover mechanism to resolve the problem of the voiceover ending prematurely in various languages
14. The account system has been upgraded to LI PASS
15. Added the Data Repeater in the store for purchase
16. Increased the cap for the backpack, you can store up to 500 materials/equipment/cuisine now
17. Made it possible to collect Artificial Island resources via the Building screen directly and don't need to transport to Artificial Island
18. Adjusted the rewards from Dream Machine play mode
19. Moved Spacetime Domain under the play mode Dimensional Trials
20. Removed play mode Omnium Beacon
a) Achievements related to Omnium Beacon will be replaced by Skilled Pioneer, Expert Pioneer, Master Pioneer (Wanderers who already completed the previous Achievements can't complete these Achievements again);
b) The current Omnium collector(s) in the backpack will be converted to items that Wanderers can obtain after successfully completing the Omnium Beacon. Wanderers will receive them directly in their backpacks in the first login after the version update.

Sincerely,
Tower of Fantasy Team

notes.title: Tower of Fantasy Steam version Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
notes.notes:
Greetings, Wanderers!
Tower of Fantasy will be available on Steam from October 20. We welcome both new and existing Wanderers to enter Vera Sector via Steam and start a magical adventure in the desert and Mirroria. We have prepared a Steam version adventure guide just for you!

Frequently Asked Questions (Key Information)
Is there a difference between the Steam version and the official version?
No. All content, including modes, operation events, and purchases, are the same and updated synchronously.

Are the Steam version and official version synched?
Character information is fully synced between platforms. Your characters, progress, resources, and purchases on iOS, Android, PC: Official, and PC: Steam will be shared between all platforms.
Cross-platform is also enabled, allowing you to play with Wanderers on other platforms.

Can my existing progress and characters in the official version be accessed on Steam?
Of course. There are two ways to access your progress on Steam:
1.	Directly log in to Steam version with your original account. Steam version will support customized email accounts login and third-party accounts login (we recommend using your original account first if you have one).
2.	You can bind your official account with your Steam account to sync your characters over multiple accounts. Please note that account binding requires specific steps. In order to prevent losses that may arise from errors in the binding process, please make sure to read "How to bind a Steam account" included in this FAQ.

Frequently Asked Questions (Downloading/Installation/Updates)
How do I download Tower of Fantasy from Steam Store?
Just like any other Steam game that you've played, you can search for Tower of Fantasy in Steam Store and download it for free from its store page.
If you've received an Ad or email, you can click on the link provided to be redirected to Steam Store page and download the game.

Why can't I download Tower of Fantasy from Steam Store, or do I receive a prompt that Tower of Fantasy is unavailable in my region?
We regret to inform you that we may be unable to provide our services on Steam in your country or region at this time due to local regulations or platform policies. Due to the varying policies adopted by each platform, you can try using other platforms (e.g., the official PC version) to play the game.

I have the launcher and client from the official version. Do I have to re-download the game? 
Yes. The launcher and client for the official and Steam versions are not interoperable. Even if you have the Official version, you must download the launcher and client via Steam Store to access the Steam version.

Is there a difference between the launchers of the Steam version and the official version?
The launcher is required for account registration, logging in, and launching the client. In addition, you can view the latest news and announcements in the launcher. But unlike the official version, you will be downloading, updating, and repairing Tower of Fantasy via Steam Store.


Frequently Asked Questions (Registration & Logging In & Account Binding)
What are the avenues available for logging in via Steam version?
The Steam version allows logging in via email, Steam account, Apple ID, Google, Facebook, Twitter, and Line.
When not using a Steam account to log in, the overall login process is similar to the Official version. Follow the steps to complete email or third-party account verification and login.
When using a Steam account to log in, your current Steam account will be used to log in immediately. Please note that if you haven't bound your existing account to your Steam account, registration will be completed automatically upon logging in for the first time. You will be unable to bind your existing account to your Steam account once that happens. If you need to bind an existing account, please complete the binding process before logging in.

How to bind a Steam account?
1.	Log in to the launcher (Official version or Steam version), then click on Account Center in the top right corner.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/706c87c58fec7c50c35ba6552e51ff36b4032af4.png
2.	Select the Bind Account tab, then click on the Bind button to the right of Steam.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/afa75df9ec8c263c42aef4be89bc847fe68a5f7a.png
3.	Complete the Steam verification process and bind the account.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/bb238c0a7de3580aec8f6fc1b4ddc4812feca783.png
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/753a25dd3db8c25768d2ac2be27ceba75614d6b7.png

Can I log in to the same account through different login avenues?
Yes, a single account supports logging in through multiple avenues. You can bind your account with all seven login methods in the PC version.


Frequently Asked Questions (Gameplay & Payment)
What are the supported game languages and voice-over languages?
The current version supports English, Japanese, German, French, Portuguese, Spanish, Indonesian, and Thai. Voice-over is only supported in English and Japanese. You can switch freely between supported game languages and voice-over languages in the in-game interface Settings - Language.

Will my Steam friend list be synched with my in-game friend list?
We regret to inform you that Steam friend lists are not supported for now. You can still add friends and play together in-game.

Are Steam achievements and trading cards supported?
We regret to inform you that Steam achievements and trading cards are not supported for now. We will complete the development of these features as soon as possible.

How do I make payments in the Steam version. Is the Official version's MidasPay supported?
Regardless of which login avenue you use, Steam Wallet is the only payment processor supported by the Steam Client (however, since account data is synched, purchases made in the Official version will be accessible in the Steam version).
The payment process is as follows:
1.	Select an item in-game and click on the icon to open the Steam payment page.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/d075d76adea19c385ee4b08ac031a79dbd59f96a.png
2.	Verify the information displayed is accurate. (Please note that due to real-time exchange rate fluctuations and currency support issues, the currency and price displayed in your bill may differ from the currency and price displayed in-game. Please refer to the bill for the accurate currency and pricing.)
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42577590/d72642612dac0dabf90f7f3f2a1750001b4c298a.png
3.	When your Steam Wallet balance is sufficient, click on [Add Funds] to deduct the corresponding amount and complete the purchase. Once completed, you can return to the game and check if your purchase has been credited to your account.
4.	When your Steam Wallet balance is insufficient, click on [Add Funds] to select your preferred payment method to add funds to your Steam Wallet and complete the purchase.

You can also opt to make purchases for your account via other platforms, including iOS: App Store, Google Play: Google Wallet, PC Official: Midas Pay, Official Website: MidasBuy (https://www.midasbuy.com/tof/toweroffantasy-global).

I have encountered an issue. How do I contact you?
You can contact us directly via Steam's Community Discussions and Customer Service. Our Official Communication Channels are also open to Steam users.
1.	Customer Service Email: support@toweroffantasy-global.com
2.	Customer Service: In-game via Settings - Customer Service. You can also contact our customer service personnel via the Customer Service Feedback option at the top right corner of the PC launcher.
